etymologies.etymologyHTML: From life +‎ boat.

definitions.definition: (nautical) A boat especially designed for saving the lives of shipwrecked people or people in distress at sea (either launched from the shore with a crew, or else carried on board a larger ship).

quote.citation: 1971, Alice Cooper, Glen Buxton, Michael Bruce, Dennis Dunaway, Neal Smith (lyrics and music), “Halo of Flies”, in Killer, performed by Alice Cooper:
quote.text: I've got a watch that turns into a lifeboat

definitions.definition: (science fiction) An emergency vehicle carried aboard a spaceship.
To rescue; to carry to safety
